## Scope

## Checklist

- [ ] `./scripts/validate-plugins.sh` passes locally

- [ ] Registered in `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` (new plugins)

- [ ] Text follows `docs/writing-style.md` (no AI tells, sentence case)
